title: Up up and away
text: First time to do this and it was an amazing experience for me and my family, it was all worth it. Nicholas our pilot and his team are amazing. This is highly recommended. Will do it again if I’ll go back in Vic Barcelona
author: analea_p

title: A must do experience
text: A early morning pickup from close to the hotel, then a drive to the balloon. We had a great time, flying about the clouds for a spectacular view.
author: Julie_S

title: Wonderful experience
text: Wonderful experience. Very well organised, very kid friendly, even though it was a foggy day we had a great view above the clouds, a truly memorable experience. The driver looked like Stanley Tucci which was a welcome bonus 😍
author: sgroszewski

title: Unforgettable
text: It has been a really cool experience. And the people from the company have made it unforgettable. Thank you very much.
author: Q2118WUfernandop

title: super experience great crew.
text: Super experience. The crew was very professional and even though we had fog they dealt with the weather to make sure we enjoiyed ourselves. Everything went well from pickup to return drop off.
author: sean_r

title: Incredible experience
text: Friendly, knowledgeable pilots and ground crew, well-organized, good value for the money, and we felt very safe from start to finish. They made every effort to show us a good time and help us create wonderful memories that we will cherish for the rest of our lives. Thank you Ballooning Barcelona!
author: xThereSheGoesx

title: Barcelona from the Skies
text: This tour was so much fun. Definitely a tick off the bucket list for all the family. Our pilot Angel was amazing and the transport to and from the landing site was very smooth. A for sure recommendation if you are in Barcelona.
author: lynseyz2020

title: Highly recommend
text: 100% must do! Best experience. Beautiful views and amazing crew to support you through the process. Highly recommend if your looking for a little bit of a thrill and an experience like no other!
author: Declan_L

title: Fantastic Experience!
text: We did a private balloon ride and were picked up by Domi at exactly the scheduled time 6:30am. The drive to the takeoff location was about 45-60’ with a brief coffee breakfast stop on route. Nicolas was our pilot and the owner. We were present as the ballon was being filled which was cool to see. Liftoff was seamless and once in the air it was smooth sailing. Nicolas was super professional, knowledgeable, funny and pleasant for the entire time the four of us were inflight in the basket with him. title: Amazing experience
text: Felt very safe. Pilot and driver were very friendly and knowledgeable. Fanatic view. The whole experience was peaceful and enjoyable. Highly recommended
